about: A tame creature notices the company for the first time: by species, by the time of day, and by whether it is under a roof. A creature's own words (Greets "..." in Kyr) are said instead.

lines.text: {Actor} gets up, stretches, and comes over to push {their} nose into your hand.
{Actor} thumps {their} tail on the ground without getting up, which is as much welcome as you are going to get.
{Actor} barks twice, for form's sake, then comes to see who you are.
{Actor} lifts {their} head, decides you are no business of {theirs}, and puts it down again.
{Actor} watches you from somewhere high, unblinking, and does not come down.
{Actor} winds once round your ankles and goes off about {their} business.
{Actor} blows through {their} nose at you, and puts {their} head out to be noticed.
{Actor} stops chewing long enough to look at you.
{Actor} complains about you to the others.
{Actor} grunts, hopefully, in case you have brought something.
{Actor} turns {their} great head to look at you, and goes on chewing.
{Actor} comes to see who you are.
